gaps.lead: Assembling the wardrobe took me two hours.
gaps.explanation: it took me X to do = I spent X doing.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly so that the interpreter could follow.
No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: She left early because she didn't want to miss the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.

gaps.lead: She'll be on a flight, so she can't join the call.
gaps.sentence: She'll be on a flight, so ___ join the call.
gaps.explanation: won't be able to = future inability.

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he refuses to read instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he refuses = far too impatient to.
